testing_and_cli.name: Testing with dotnet test
testing_and_cli.description: Modern guidance for dotnet test with Microsoft.Testing.Platform mode in .NET 10
testing_and_cli.notes: Primary source: VSTest is the default mode of `dotnet test` on .NET 10 SDK ('This is the default mode for dotnet test'); MTP mode is opt-in via a `test.runner` entry in global.json. TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport defaults to false. Corrects an earlier version of this skill that claimed MTP was on by default.

testing_and_cli.name: Announcing .NET 10
testing_and_cli.notes: .NET 10 GA November 11 2025; LTS supported until November 10 2028. Source for version/date facts used in MTP and preflight guidance.

testing_and_cli.name: MTP adoption across test frameworks
testing_and_cli.notes: Confirms MTP is stable and gaining framework adoption; does NOT say MTP is the default dotnet-test mode on .NET 10 — VSTest remains default, MTP is opt-in via global.json (corrected 2026-07-11, verified against learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/testing/unit-testing-with-dotnet-test). xUnit v3/TUnit are MTP-only; NUnit/MSTest support both.

testing_and_cli.name: NUKE issue #1584 — MTP not yet supported
testing_and_cli.notes: Opened Dec 22 2025, confirmed OPEN as of 2026-07-11 (re-checked via `gh issue view`). NUKE DotNetTest helper is VSTest-oriented; MTP 'is not yet supported'. Thread has 4 comments from affected users, none from the NUKE maintainer, no linked PR or milestone. Authoritative source for the NUKE+MTP limitation documented in test-platform-modes-and-cli.md.
